2608.07405.title: GeoDistill-Refine: Silhouette-First Geometry Distillation for Annotation-Free Spacecraft Segmentation
2608.07405.paper_summary: Foundation segmentation models can provide supervision for spacecraft imagery without manual training masks, but their predictions vary with textual prompts and may contain geometric errors that are amplified during distillation. This paper presents GeoDistill-Refine, a two-stage framework that transfers offline SAM 3 pseudo-masks to a compact segmentation network. Six fixed prompts are fused by an unweighted 50% vote to stabilize the teacher output. The student first learns the foreground silhouette and is then refined with signed-distance-field, skeleton, and area objectives derived from the pseudo-mask. A sample-level gate, computed from prompt agreement, the valid-prompt ratio, and pseudo-mask area plausibility, reduces the influence of unreliable pseudo-geometry. On the SpaceSense-Bench HJM lockbox set, GeoDistill-Refine improves Image IoU and Boundary F1 by 0.0456 and 0.1380, respectively, over a plain pseudo-label student. External evaluations on the SPEED+ Lightbox and Sunlamp domains and on TANGO show competitive regional overlap together with gains in boundary quality or foreground precision. The deployed TinyUNet contains 0.263 M parameters and requires approximately 1.1 ms per image on an RTX 4090; SAM 3 pseudo-mask construction and the auxiliary geometry branches are used only during training.
2608.07405.paper_summary_zh: 基礎分割模型可以在沒有手動訓練標記的情況下為航天器影像提供監督，但它們的預測會根據文本提示而變化，並可能包含在蒸餾過程中放大的幾何錯誤。本文提出了GeoDistill-Refine，一個將離線SAM 3偽標記轉移到緊湊分割網絡的兩階段框架。六個固定的提示通過無權重的50%投票進行融合，以穩定教師輸出。學生首先學習前景輪廓，然後通過從偽標記中衍生的簽名距離場、骨架和面積目標進行精煉。從提示一致性、有效提示比率和偽標記面積合理性計算的樣本級門控，減少了不可靠偽幾何的影響。在SpaceSense-Bench HJM鎖箱集上，GeoDistill-Refine相比於普通的偽標籤學生，分別提高了圖像IoU和邊界F1指標0.0456和0.1380。在SPEED+ Lightbox和Sunlamp領域以及在TANGO上的外部評估顯示出競爭性的區域重疊，並伴隨著邊界質量或前景精度的提升。部署的TinyUNet包含0.263 M參數，並在RTX 4090上每張圖像約需1.1毫秒；SAM 3偽標記構建和輔助幾何分支僅在訓練期間使用。
